summary: D1-PR-005 correctly blocks retry after failed Full Test, but full-test remains allowed in awaiting-user-decision. The frozen Full Test state machine requires the owner authorization transition to authorized before execution; an authorization reference alone cannot bypass that Delivery state.

blockingFindings.title: full-test is permitted before the Delivery reaches authorized
blockingFindings.evidence: The Proposal permits full-test for deliveryFullTestStatus in {awaiting-user-decision, authorized} when an authorization scope exists. Frozen verification-model.md defines awaiting-user-decision -> authorized -> passed|failed and states that a Full Test must not execute while not authorized. This permits Policy to bypass the explicit Delivery substate transition.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Require deliveryFullTestStatus = authorized for canRun(full-test). In awaiting-user-decision, next must return authorize-full-test when owner authorization is absent; recording/accepting authorization must transition the authoritative Delivery fact to authorized before full-test is legal. Add table-driven cases showing awaiting-user-decision is never runnable, authorized is runnable only with the required authorization, and failed/passed remain non-runnable. Update Design, Spec, Tasks, and diagnostics consistently.

resolvedFindings.resolution: failed now returns blocked full-test-failed and does not permit direct full-test retry; the corrective Change reset path is documented and tested.
